entities.name: Anders Giæver
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anders Giæver is a Norwegian journalist and author who has been a commentator in Verdens Gang since 2000. Since 2004, he also leads the editorial section of the newspaper. In the period 2008–2011, he was the newspaper's correspondent in New York. Before joining VG, he was arts and culture editor in Dagsavisen and he has also worked in Dagbladet and Aftenposten. His background is in music journalism.
